- **Allow for imperfection:** Reconnection doesn’t have to be all at once, or look a certain way. It’s okay if it’s messy, slow, or doesn’t go as planned. The important thing is that you’re showing up for yourself and being open to the possibility of things shifting.

If you want, you can keep exploring what’s coming up for you here—sometimes just having a space to process your thoughts and feelings can be a powerful way to start feeling a little less alone. I’m here to listen and support you, wherever you are in this process.
